sets.example_en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
sets.example_zh: 孩子抬头看着那个鲜红的气球。
sets.explain_zh: up后接地点名词可作介词，如up the hill。

sets.example_en: As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.
sets.example_zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多年轻人发现独立生活变得更加困难。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
sets.example_zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。
sets.explain_zh: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

sets.example_en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
sets.example_zh: 这只鞋合脚，但另一只在哪里？
sets.explain_zh: other后接名词；others独立使用；两者中另一个用the other。

sets.example_en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。
sets.explain_zh: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。

sets.example_en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
sets.example_zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。
sets.explain_zh: good是形容词；修饰动作通常用well。

sets.example_en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。
sets.explain_zh: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

sets.example_en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
sets.example_zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。
sets.explain_zh: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

sets.example_en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
sets.example_zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

sets.example_en: Companies should take responsibility for the waste they produce.
sets.example_zh: 企业应对其产生的废物负责。

sets.example_en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
sets.example_zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

sets.example_en: She sings very well.
sets.example_zh: 她唱得很好。

sets.example_en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
sets.example_zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。
sets.explain_zh: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
sets.example_zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。
sets.explain_zh: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

sets.example_en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
sets.example_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
sets.example_zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。
sets.explain_zh: 作副词可指仅仅、刚刚；作形容词指公正的。

sets.example_en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
sets.example_zh: 一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
sets.example_zh: 进来在火边暖暖手吧。
sets.explain_zh: 不规则变化：come–came–come；come from表示来自。

sets.example_en: Could you open the window, please?
sets.example_zh: 你能打开窗户吗？

sets.example_en: My aunt will work at the hospital on night shifts.
sets.example_zh: 我阿姨将在医院上夜班。

sets.example_en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
sets.example_zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？
sets.explain_zh: 动词读/juːz/，名词读/juːs/。

sets.example_en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
sets.example_zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
sets.example_zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。
sets.explain_zh: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

sets.example_en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
sets.example_zh: 我们现在住在车站附近，步行过去很方便。
sets.explain_zh: now that引导原因从句，强调情况已发生变化。

sets.example_en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
sets.example_zh: 既然在线课程已广泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同时继续接受教育。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: First wash your hands, then eat.
sets.example_zh: 先洗手，然后再吃。

sets.example_en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。
sets.explain_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

sets.example_en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
sets.example_zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。
sets.explain_zh: into强调进入的过程；in通常表示在里面。

sets.example_en: She is the only child in her family.
sets.example_zh: 她是家里唯一的孩子。

sets.example_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
sets.example_zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。
sets.explain_zh: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

sets.example_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
sets.example_zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
sets.example_zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。
sets.explain_zh: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

sets.example_en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
sets.example_zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。
sets.explain_zh: give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

sets.example_en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
sets.example_zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。
sets.explain_zh: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

sets.example_en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
sets.example_zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。
sets.explain_zh: be new to表示初次接触、不熟悉，to是介词。

sets.example_en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
sets.example_zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。
sets.explain_zh: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

sets.example_en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
sets.example_zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
sets.example_zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

sets.example_en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
sets.example_zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。
sets.explain_zh: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。

sets.example_en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
sets.example_zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
sets.example_zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。
sets.explain_zh: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

sets.example_en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。
sets.explain_zh: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

sets.example_en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
sets.example_zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。
sets.explain_zh: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

sets.example_en: Where is the nearest supermarket?
sets.example_zh: 最近的超市在哪里？

sets.example_en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
sets.example_zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？
sets.explain_zh: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

sets.example_en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
sets.example_zh: 这里大多数商店在我们下班前就关门了。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指用most people；特指用most of the people。

sets.example_en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
sets.example_zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。
sets.explain_zh: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

sets.example_en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
sets.example_zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。
sets.explain_zh: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

sets.example_en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 我们剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。
sets.explain_zh: 修饰不可数名词；可数名词复数用many。

sets.example_en: Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.
sets.example_zh: 投资预防性医疗可能比在疾病变得严重后再治疗经济得多。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: You picked the right key to open the door.
sets.example_zh: 你选对了开门的钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: 表示权利用a right to；表示在右边用on the right。

sets.example_en: How do you go to school?
sets.example_zh: 你怎么去学校？

sets.example_en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
sets.example_zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。
sets.explain_zh: go back表示回去；back作动词可表示支持。

sets.example_en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
sets.example_zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。
sets.explain_zh: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

sets.example_en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
sets.example_zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。
sets.explain_zh: even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

sets.example_en: You may leave when the listening test is over.
sets.example_zh: 听力考试结束后你可以离开。

sets.example_en: Please sit here next to me.
sets.example_zh: 请坐在我旁边这里。

sets.example_en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
sets.example_zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？
sets.explain_zh: many 接可数名词复数；much 接不可数名词。

sets.example_en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
sets.example_zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
sets.example_zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。
sets.explain_zh: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

sets.example_en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
sets.example_zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
sets.example_zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。
sets.explain_zh: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

sets.example_en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
sets.example_zh: 那个孩子小心翼翼地端着一碗水走到外面。
sets.explain_zh: 复数是children；childish偏贬义，childlike指天真如孩童。

sets.example_en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
sets.example_zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。
sets.explain_zh: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

sets.example_en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
sets.example_zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。
sets.explain_zh: not really通常表示“不太”，语气比直接说no缓和。

sets.example_en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
sets.example_zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。
sets.explain_zh: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

sets.example_en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
sets.example_zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。
sets.explain_zh: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

sets.example_en: My sister works for a company that makes bicycles.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐在一家制造自行车的公司工作。
sets.explain_zh: 表“公司”可数；表“陪伴”不可数。

sets.example_en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
sets.example_zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。
sets.explain_zh: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

sets.example_en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
sets.example_zh: 猫从厨房的桌子上跳了下来。
sets.explain_zh: down后接名词可作介词；feel down表示心情低落。

sets.example_en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
sets.example_zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

sets.example_en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
sets.example_zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
sets.example_zh: 自从搬到乡下，我们的生活感觉更安静了。
sets.explain_zh: 复数是 lives；泛指生活时通常不可数。

sets.example_en: The chart compares life expectancy in several regions.
sets.example_zh: 图表比较了几个地区的预期寿命。

sets.example_en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
sets.example_zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。
sets.explain_zh: 复数为men；泛指人类时现代写作更常用humankind。

sets.example_en: Governments should change transport policies to encourage cycling and reduce dependence on private cars in cities.
sets.example_zh: 政府应调整交通政策，鼓励骑行并减少城市居民对私家车的依赖。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“零钱、找零”时不可数，不能说a change。

sets.example_en: The report examines how climate change affects coastal communities.
sets.example_zh: 报告考察气候变化如何影响沿海社区。

sets.example_en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
sets.example_zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。
sets.explain_zh: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

sets.example_en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
sets.example_zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。
sets.explain_zh: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

sets.example_en: Investing in insulation can reduce costs in the long term.
sets.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资保温设施能够降低成本。

sets.example_en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
sets.example_zh: 猫从沙发和墙之间挤了过去。
sets.explain_zh: between不只限于两者，也可用于多个明确对象之间。

sets.example_en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
sets.example_zh: 盖着这条柔软的毯子，我觉得暖和多了。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为felt；feel后可直接接形容词。

sets.example_en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
sets.example_zh: 这汤现在太烫，还不能喝。
sets.explain_zh: too强调超过合适程度；very只强调程度高。

sets.example_en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
sets.example_zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。
sets.explain_zh: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

sets.example_en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
sets.example_zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。
sets.explain_zh: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

sets.example_en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
sets.example_zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please write your address on this small card.
sets.example_zh: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。
sets.explain_zh: 不规则变化：write—wrote—written。

sets.example_en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
sets.example_zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。
sets.explain_zh: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

sets.example_en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
sets.example_zh: 我们今天买了很多新鲜水果。
sets.explain_zh: a lot of接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot可修饰动词。

sets.example_en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
sets.example_zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。
sets.explain_zh: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

sets.example_en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
sets.example_zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
sets.example_zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。
sets.explain_zh: try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

sets.example_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
sets.example_zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。
sets.explain_zh: leave 的过去式和过去分词均为 left。

sets.example_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
sets.example_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
sets.explain_zh: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。

sets.example_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
sets.example_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
sets.example_zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。
sets.explain_zh: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

sets.example_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
sets.example_zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。
sets.explain_zh: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

sets.example_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
sets.example_zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I understood only the opening part of that story.
sets.example_zh: 那个故事我只读懂了开头的部分。

sets.example_en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。
sets.explain_zh: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

sets.example_en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
sets.example_zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
sets.example_zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。
sets.explain_zh: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

sets.example_en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
sets.example_zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？
sets.explain_zh: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

sets.example_en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
sets.example_zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。
sets.explain_zh: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

sets.example_en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
sets.example_zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

sets.example_en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
sets.example_zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。
sets.explain_zh: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

sets.example_en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
sets.example_zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。
sets.explain_zh: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

sets.example_en: There is something soft inside this little box.
sets.example_zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。
sets.explain_zh: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

sets.example_en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
sets.example_zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
sets.example_zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

sets.example_en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
sets.example_zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。
sets.explain_zh: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

sets.example_en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
sets.example_zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。
sets.explain_zh: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

sets.example_en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。
sets.explain_zh: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

sets.example_en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
sets.example_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
sets.example_zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

sets.example_en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
sets.example_zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。
sets.explain_zh: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

sets.example_en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
sets.example_zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
sets.example_zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。
sets.explain_zh: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

sets.example_en: We walk to school together along the river.
sets.example_zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。
sets.explain_zh: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

sets.example_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
sets.example_zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。
sets.explain_zh: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

sets.example_en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
sets.example_zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
sets.example_zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。
sets.explain_zh: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

sets.example_en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
sets.example_zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。
sets.explain_zh: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

sets.example_en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
sets.example_zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。
sets.explain_zh: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

sets.example_en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
sets.example_zh: 我们要坐的下一班公交车大约十分钟后发车。
sets.explain_zh: “下周”用next week，不加the；the next week指随后一周。

sets.example_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
sets.example_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
sets.explain_zh: at the end指末尾；in the end指最终。

sets.example_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
sets.example_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
sets.example_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。
sets.explain_zh: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

sets.example_en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
sets.example_zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？
sets.explain_zh: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

sets.example_en: Don't talk while you are eating.
sets.example_zh: 吃饭时不要说话。

sets.example_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
sets.example_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
sets.explain_zh: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。

sets.example_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
sets.example_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
sets.example_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
sets.explain_zh: last/next/this week前不加介词。

sets.example_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
sets.example_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
sets.example_zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。
sets.explain_zh: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

sets.example_en: Public libraries play a role in supporting community learning.
sets.example_zh: 公共图书馆在支持社区学习方面发挥作用。

sets.example_en: It might rain this afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 今天下午可能会下雨。

sets.example_en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
sets.example_zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。
sets.explain_zh: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

sets.example_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
sets.example_zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。
sets.explain_zh: home作副词时前面不加to：go home。

sets.example_en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
sets.example_zh: 我出门从来都带着水瓶。
sets.explain_zh: 通常放在实义动词前，be动词或助动词后。

sets.example_en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
sets.example_zh: 这个价格包含早餐和一条干净毛巾吗？
sets.explain_zh: include常列出部分内容，不表示完整清单。

sets.example_en: I joined a cooking course at the community centre.
sets.example_zh: 我报名参加了社区中心的烹饪课程。
sets.explain_zh: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

sets.example_en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。
sets.explain_zh: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

sets.example_en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
sets.example_zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。
sets.explain_zh: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

sets.example_en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
sets.example_zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。
sets.explain_zh: a group of后常接复数名词；动词常用group A by B。

sets.example_en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
sets.example_zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
sets.example_zh: 带把伞吧，以防待会儿下雨。
sets.explain_zh: in case后接从句；in case of后接名词。

sets.example_en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
sets.example_zh: 隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。
sets.explain_zh: 复数women读/ˈwɪmɪn/，注意首音节变化。

sets.example_en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
sets.example_zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。
sets.explain_zh: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

sets.example_en: She read a picture book to the children.
sets.example_zh: 她给孩子们读了一本图画书。
sets.explain_zh: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

sets.example_en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
sets.example_zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。
sets.explain_zh: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

sets.example_en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
sets.example_zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
sets.example_zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。
sets.explain_zh: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

sets.example_en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
sets.example_zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。
sets.explain_zh: let sb do sth中不加to；过去式、过去分词均为let。

sets.example_en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
sets.example_zh: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？
sets.explain_zh: again表示重复；again and again强调反复多次。

sets.example_en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
sets.example_zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。
sets.explain_zh: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

sets.example_en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
sets.example_zh: 雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为kept；继续做用keep doing。

sets.example_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
sets.example_zh: 我能听见卧室窗外的鸟鸣声。
sets.explain_zh: hear强调听见；listen to强调主动听。过去式heard。

sets.example_en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
sets.example_zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。
sets.explain_zh: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

sets.example_en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
sets.example_zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
sets.example_zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。
sets.explain_zh: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。

sets.example_en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
sets.example_zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。
sets.explain_zh: 动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

sets.example_en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
sets.example_zh: 音乐会期间请将手机调为静音。
sets.explain_zh: during后接名词；while后常接句子；for表示持续时长。

sets.example_en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
sets.example_zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。
sets.explain_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

sets.example_en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
sets.example_zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
sets.example_zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。
sets.explain_zh: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

sets.example_en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
sets.example_zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
sets.example_zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。

sets.example_en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
sets.example_zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。
sets.explain_zh: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

sets.example_en: I study English on the bus every morning.
sets.example_zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。
sets.explain_zh: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

sets.example_en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
sets.example_zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
sets.example_zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。
sets.explain_zh: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

sets.example_en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
sets.example_zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

sets.example_en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
sets.example_zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。
sets.explain_zh: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

sets.example_en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
sets.example_zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
sets.example_zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。
sets.explain_zh: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

sets.example_en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
sets.example_zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
sets.example_zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式ran，过去分词run；现在分词running。

sets.example_en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
sets.example_zh: 猫蜷缩在厨房的桌子下面。
sets.explain_zh: under可表位置、数量或状态：under pressure。

sets.example_en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
sets.example_zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。
sets.explain_zh: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

sets.example_en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。
sets.explain_zh: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

sets.example_en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
sets.example_zh: 你来时请带一件暖和的外套。
sets.explain_zh: bring强调带到说话者或指定地点；过去式brought。

sets.example_en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 我们赶上了一班早车，在早餐前就到了。
sets.explain_zh: early兼作形容词和副词，不加-ly。

sets.example_en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
sets.example_zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。
sets.explain_zh: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

sets.example_en: The scheme saves money; on the other hand, it may increase travel time.
sets.example_zh: 这项方案节省费用；另一方面，它可能增加出行时间。

sets.example_en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。
sets.explain_zh: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

sets.example_en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
sets.example_zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？
sets.explain_zh: moving指令人感动的，moved指感到感动的。

sets.example_en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
sets.example_zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I saved enough money to buy a new bicycle.
sets.example_zh: 我攒够了买一辆新自行车的钱。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数：说much money，不说many money。

sets.example_en: It is a fact that sound travels faster through water than through air.
sets.example_zh: 声音在水里比在空气里传得更快，这是事实。
sets.explain_zh: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
sets.example_zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。
sets.explain_zh: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

sets.example_en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
sets.example_zh: 湖边有一处安静的野餐区。
sets.explain_zh: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

sets.example_en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
sets.example_zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。
sets.explain_zh: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

sets.example_en: What name did you choose for your new kitten?
sets.example_zh: 你给新来的小猫取了什么名字？
sets.explain_zh: 英式name A after B表示以B的名字命名A。

sets.example_en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
sets.example_zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。
sets.explain_zh: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

sets.example_en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。
sets.explain_zh: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

sets.example_en: I put aside a little money every month.
sets.example_zh: 我每个月都会存下一点钱。
sets.explain_zh: last、next、every month前通常不加介词。

sets.example_en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
sets.example_zh: 一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。
sets.explain_zh: large number接可数名词，large amount接不可数名词。

sets.example_en: Business is usually slow at the café on Mondays.
sets.example_zh: 这家咖啡馆周一的生意通常比较清淡。
sets.explain_zh: 指商业活动时不可数；指具体企业时可数。

sets.example_en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

sets.example_en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
sets.example_zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。
sets.explain_zh: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

sets.example_en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
sets.example_zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
sets.example_zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。
sets.explain_zh: be open表示开着的状态；open作动词表示打开的动作。

sets.example_en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
sets.example_zh: 请把这些照片按正确顺序排列。
sets.explain_zh: in order指按顺序；in order to后接动词，表示为了。

sets.example_en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
sets.example_zh: 政府计划在附近建一所新医院。
sets.explain_zh: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

sets.example_en: Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府在提供可负担住房和维持基本公共服务方面发挥着关键作用。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
sets.example_zh: 我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。
sets.explain_zh: keep your word指守信，其中word不用复数。

sets.example_en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。
sets.explain_zh: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。

sets.example_en: The report examines changes in the local labour market.
sets.example_zh: 报告考察当地劳动力市场的变化。

sets.example_en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
sets.example_zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？
sets.explain_zh: pay for接所购物品；pay接账单或款额；过去式paid。

sets.example_en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

sets.example_en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
sets.example_zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？
sets.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。

sets.example_en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
sets.example_zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。
sets.explain_zh: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

sets.example_en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。
sets.explain_zh: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

sets.example_en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
sets.example_zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。
sets.explain_zh: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

sets.example_en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
sets.example_zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: This is my second cup of tea today.
sets.example_zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。
sets.explain_zh: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。

sets.example_en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
sets.example_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。
sets.explain_zh: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

sets.example_en: Yes, I can help you with that.
sets.example_zh: 是的，我可以帮你。

sets.example_en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。
sets.explain_zh: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

sets.example_en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
sets.example_zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

sets.example_en: My sister found a job at the local library.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。
sets.explain_zh: job指具体工作，可数；work泛指工作，通常不可数。

sets.example_en: Flexible schedules may improve job satisfaction for some employees.
sets.example_zh: 灵活的工作安排可能提高部分员工的工作满意度。

sets.example_en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
sets.example_zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。
sets.explain_zh: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

sets.example_en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
sets.example_zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。
sets.explain_zh: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

sets.example_en: The bridge closed, and as a result, traffic moved to another route.
sets.example_zh: 这座桥关闭，因此车辆改走了另一条路线。

sets.example_en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
sets.example_zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。
sets.explain_zh: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

sets.example_en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
sets.example_zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？
sets.explain_zh: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

sets.example_en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
sets.example_zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
sets.example_zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。
sets.explain_zh: 不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。

sets.example_en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
sets.example_zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。
sets.explain_zh: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

sets.example_en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
sets.example_zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。
sets.explain_zh: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

sets.example_en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
sets.example_zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
sets.example_zh: 请在雨飘进来之前关上窗户。
sets.explain_zh: 动词读/z/；形容词和副词读/s/。

sets.example_en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
sets.example_zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。
sets.explain_zh: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

sets.example_en: Poor access to public transport can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
sets.example_zh: 公共交通不便可能导致人们更加依赖私家车。
sets.explain_zh: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。

sets.example_en: Poor access to public transport can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
sets.example_zh: 公共交通不便可能导致人们更加依赖私家车。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

sets.example_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
sets.example_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

sets.example_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
sets.example_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We thank the cooks when the festival dinner ends.
sets.example_zh: 节日晚宴结束时，我们感谢厨师们。

sets.example_en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
sets.example_zh: 我们走了很远，走得脚都开始疼了。
sets.explain_zh: far可修饰比较级，如far better；不用far good。

sets.example_en: Reliable public transport can make commuting far more affordable for people who live outside major city centres.
sets.example_zh: 可靠的公共交通可以让住在大城市中心以外的人通勤时省下很多钱。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
sets.example_zh: 今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。
sets.explain_zh: today既可指今天，也可泛指当今；前面不用on。

sets.example_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
sets.example_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
sets.explain_zh: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

sets.example_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
sets.example_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
sets.example_zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。
sets.explain_zh: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

sets.example_en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。
sets.explain_zh: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

sets.example_en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
sets.example_zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。
sets.explain_zh: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

sets.example_en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
sets.example_zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。
sets.explain_zh: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。

sets.example_en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
sets.example_zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。
sets.explain_zh: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

sets.example_en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
sets.example_zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。
sets.explain_zh: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

sets.example_en: My room has a desk beside the window.
sets.example_zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。
sets.explain_zh: 指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

sets.example_en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
sets.example_zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。
sets.explain_zh: until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

sets.example_en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
sets.example_zh: 大雨是我们待在家里的原因。
sets.explain_zh: 常用reason for加名词，或reason why加从句。

sets.example_en: One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.
sets.example_zh: 城市租金上涨的一个原因是住房供应未能跟上人口增长。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
sets.example_zh: 那些云呈现出一只巨兔的形状。
sets.explain_zh: fill in a form是英式说法；美式常用fill out a form。

sets.example_en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
sets.example_zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。
sets.explain_zh: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

sets.example_en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
sets.example_zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。
sets.explain_zh: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

sets.example_en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
sets.example_zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。
sets.explain_zh: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

sets.example_en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
sets.example_zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。
sets.explain_zh: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。

sets.example_en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
sets.example_zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。
sets.explain_zh: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

sets.example_en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
sets.example_zh: 只有一个人在面包店外等候。
sets.explain_zh: 普通复数用people；persons多见于正式法律语境。

sets.example_en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。
sets.explain_zh: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

sets.example_en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
sets.example_zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
sets.example_zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。
sets.explain_zh: once引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

sets.example_en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
sets.example_zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。
sets.explain_zh: 表示某团体的成员，用a member of。

sets.example_en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
sets.example_zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。
sets.explain_zh: 修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

sets.example_en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
sets.example_zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。
sets.explain_zh: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

sets.example_en: We explored the city on foot all afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在步行游览这座城市。
sets.explain_zh: 复数为cities；市中心英式用city centre。

sets.example_en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
sets.example_zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

sets.example_en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
sets.example_zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
sets.example_zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。
sets.explain_zh: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

sets.example_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
sets.example_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
sets.explain_zh: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

sets.example_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
sets.example_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I don't know whether he will come.
sets.example_zh: 我不知道他会不会来。

sets.example_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
sets.example_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
sets.explain_zh: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。

sets.example_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
sets.example_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: All the children were present for the class photo.
sets.example_zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。
sets.explain_zh: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

sets.example_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
sets.example_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。
sets.explain_zh: side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

sets.example_en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
sets.example_zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。
sets.explain_zh: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

sets.example_en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
sets.example_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。
sets.explain_zh: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

sets.example_en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
sets.example_zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？
sets.explain_zh: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

sets.example_en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
sets.example_zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
sets.example_zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。
sets.explain_zh: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

sets.example_en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
sets.example_zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。
sets.explain_zh: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

sets.example_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
sets.example_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
sets.explain_zh: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

sets.example_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
sets.example_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
sets.example_zh: 这个低矮的架子很方便孩子们取东西。
sets.explain_zh: 价格低用low，东西便宜用cheap。

sets.example_en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
sets.example_zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？
sets.explain_zh: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

sets.example_en: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
sets.example_zh: 你的包裹应该会在接下来的三天内送达。
sets.explain_zh: within强调不超出某范围；within a week指一周内。

sets.example_en: Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府应确保居民区步行可达的范围内有基本服务设施。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
sets.example_zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。
sets.explain_zh: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
sets.example_zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。
sets.explain_zh: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

sets.example_en: The campaign aims to increase public awareness of water conservation.
sets.example_zh: 这项活动旨在提高公众的节水意识。

sets.example_en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 我们经常在晚饭后沿河散步。
sets.explain_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；t也可发音。

sets.example_en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。
sets.explain_zh: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

sets.example_en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
sets.example_zh: 可以预订今晚的餐桌吗？
sets.explain_zh: 常用it is possible to do；不说人is possible to do。

sets.example_en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
sets.example_zh: 我以为这汤很辣，其实是甜的。
sets.explain_zh: actually表示“其实”，不表示“目前”。

sets.example_en: This soup is rather salty, but the bread is delicious.
sets.example_zh: 这汤有点咸，不过面包很好吃。
sets.explain_zh: would rather后接动词原形；rather than意为“而不是”。

sets.example_en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
sets.example_zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。
sets.explain_zh: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

sets.example_en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
sets.example_zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。
sets.explain_zh: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

sets.example_en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
sets.example_zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
sets.example_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
sets.explain_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

sets.example_en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
sets.example_zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。
sets.explain_zh: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

sets.example_en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
sets.example_zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。
sets.explain_zh: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。

sets.example_en: This bread is too hard to bite into.
sets.example_zh: 这块面包太硬了，咬不动。
sets.explain_zh: hard可作副词“努力地”；hardly意为“几乎不”。

sets.example_en: Many students work hard to gain qualifications, yet still find it difficult to secure stable employment.
sets.example_zh: 许多学生努力取得学历或资格，却仍然难以找到稳定的工作。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。
sets.explain_zh: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

sets.example_en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
sets.example_zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。
sets.explain_zh: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

sets.example_en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
sets.example_zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

sets.example_en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
sets.example_zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。
sets.explain_zh: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

sets.example_en: Her main concern is getting home before the storm.
sets.example_zh: 她最担心的是能否在暴风雨前到家。
sets.explain_zh: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

sets.example_en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
sets.example_zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。
sets.explain_zh: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

sets.example_en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
sets.example_zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。

sets.example_en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
sets.example_zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。
sets.explain_zh: 楼层英式写storey，美式写story；高度不固定。

sets.example_en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
sets.example_zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。
sets.explain_zh: almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

sets.example_en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
sets.example_zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
sets.example_zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。
sets.explain_zh: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

sets.example_en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
sets.example_zh: 请站在车门附近，等公交车停稳。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。

sets.example_en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
sets.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。
sets.explain_zh: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。

sets.example_en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
sets.example_zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

sets.example_en: This hotel offers a cheaper rate during the winter.
sets.example_zh: 这家酒店冬季的房价更便宜。
sets.explain_zh: rate可指比率或单位费用；评价某物用rate。

sets.example_en: The graph shows the unemployment rate over a ten-year period.
sets.example_zh: 图像显示了十年间的失业率。

sets.example_en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
sets.example_zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。
sets.explain_zh: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

sets.example_en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
sets.example_zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。
sets.explain_zh: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

sets.example_en: The new curtains had a calming effect on the room.
sets.example_zh: 新窗帘让房间的氛围变得宁静了。
sets.explain_zh: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

sets.example_en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
sets.example_zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？
sets.explain_zh: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

sets.example_en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
sets.example_zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
sets.example_zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？
sets.explain_zh: 问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

sets.example_en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
sets.example_zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。
sets.explain_zh: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

sets.example_en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
sets.example_zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。
sets.explain_zh: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

sets.example_en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
sets.example_zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
sets.example_zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

sets.example_en: We got a good deal on our new sofa.
sets.example_zh: 我们以很划算的价格买到了新沙发。
sets.explain_zh: deal with表示处理；a great deal of后接不可数名词。

sets.example_en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
sets.example_zh: 今天出门前请给植物浇水。
sets.explain_zh: 表示水通常不可数：a glass of water是一杯水。

sets.example_en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
sets.example_zh: 获得清洁的饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共健康至关重要。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
sets.example_zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。

sets.example_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
sets.example_zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。
sets.explain_zh: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

sets.example_en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
sets.example_zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。
sets.explain_zh: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

sets.example_en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
sets.example_zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。
sets.explain_zh: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

sets.example_en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
sets.example_zh: 沉重的底座让灯不易倒下。
sets.explain_zh: base A on B表示“以B为依据建立A”。

sets.example_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
sets.example_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
sets.explain_zh: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

sets.example_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
sets.example_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
sets.example_zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。
sets.explain_zh: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

sets.example_en: In past years our school held the fair in May.
sets.example_zh: 过去几年，我们学校都在五月举办义卖会。

sets.example_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
sets.example_zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。
sets.explain_zh: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

sets.example_en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
sets.example_zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。
sets.explain_zh: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

sets.example_en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
sets.example_zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。
sets.explain_zh: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

sets.example_en: The community center offers free language classes.
sets.example_zh: 社区中心提供免费语言课程。

sets.example_en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
sets.example_zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

sets.example_en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
sets.example_zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。
sets.explain_zh: nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

sets.example_en: Please return these library books before you go away.
sets.example_zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。
sets.explain_zh: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

sets.example_en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
sets.example_zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。
sets.explain_zh: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

sets.example_en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
sets.example_zh: 我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。
sets.explain_zh: 字母l不发音；walk the dog意为遛狗。

sets.example_en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
sets.example_zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。
sets.explain_zh: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

sets.example_en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
sets.example_zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？
sets.explain_zh: 表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

sets.example_en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
sets.example_zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

sets.example_en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
sets.example_zh: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。
sets.explain_zh: 在办公室用in the office；任公职用in office。

sets.example_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
sets.example_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
sets.explain_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

sets.example_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
sets.example_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
sets.example_zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。
sets.explain_zh: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

sets.example_en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
sets.example_zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。
sets.explain_zh: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

sets.example_en: Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
sets.example_zh: 随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。
sets.explain_zh: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

sets.example_en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
sets.example_zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。
sets.explain_zh: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

sets.example_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
sets.example_zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。
sets.explain_zh: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。

sets.example_en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
sets.example_zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。
sets.explain_zh: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

sets.example_en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。
sets.explain_zh: remember to do是记得去做；doing是记得做过。

sets.example_en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
sets.example_zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。
sets.explain_zh: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

sets.example_en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
sets.example_zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
sets.example_zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。
sets.explain_zh: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

sets.example_en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
sets.example_zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
sets.example_zh: 我以为那只鸟是塑料的，没想到是真的。
sets.explain_zh: real修饰名词；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。

sets.example_en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
sets.example_zh: 虽然平均工资上涨了，但物价上涨意味着许多劳动者的实际收入有所下降。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
sets.example_zh: 我问了价格，却没有人回答。
sets.explain_zh: 动词answer直接接问题；名词用the answer to。

sets.example_en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
sets.example_zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

sets.example_en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
sets.example_zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。
sets.explain_zh: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

sets.example_en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。
sets.explain_zh: letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

sets.example_en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
sets.example_zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
sets.example_zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。
sets.explain_zh: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

sets.example_en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
sets.example_zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。
sets.explain_zh: 指某种语言时可数；泛指语言能力时常不可数。

sets.example_en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
sets.example_zh: 学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
sets.example_zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

sets.example_en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
sets.example_zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。
sets.explain_zh: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

sets.example_en: Regular play supports a young child's development in many ways.
sets.example_zh: 经常玩耍能从多方面促进幼儿的成长。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指发展通常不可数；表示新进展时可数。

sets.example_en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
sets.example_zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。
sets.explain_zh: go into town指去市中心，此时town前不加冠词。

sets.example_en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
sets.example_zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
sets.example_zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。
sets.explain_zh: 复数为halves；“半小时”用half an hour。

sets.example_en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
sets.example_zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
sets.example_zh: 等一下，我找找钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: 会议记录用复数minutes；形容词“微小的”重音在后。

sets.example_en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
sets.example_zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

sets.example_en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
sets.example_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
sets.example_zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。
sets.explain_zh: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

sets.example_en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
sets.example_zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。
sets.explain_zh: make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

sets.example_en: We talked about our future while walking home.
sets.example_zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。
sets.explain_zh: in the future指将来；英式in future常指从今以后。

sets.example_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
sets.example_zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
sets.example_zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。
sets.explain_zh: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

sets.example_en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
sets.example_zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。
sets.explain_zh: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。

sets.example_en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
sets.example_zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。
sets.explain_zh: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

sets.example_en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
sets.example_zh: 请留在座位上，直到公交车完全停稳。
sets.explain_zh: 表示保持某状态时，后接形容词或名词，不用副词。

sets.example_en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
sets.example_zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。
sets.explain_zh: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

sets.example_en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
sets.example_zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
sets.example_zh: 我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。
sets.explain_zh: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

sets.example_en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
sets.example_zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

sets.example_en: The color of the water changed after the heavy rain.
sets.example_zh: 大雨之后，水的颜色发生了变化。

sets.example_en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。
sets.explain_zh: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

sets.example_en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
sets.example_zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。
sets.explain_zh: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

sets.example_en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
sets.example_zh: 我的新工作让我几乎没时间参加社交活动。
sets.explain_zh: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

sets.example_en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
sets.example_zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。
sets.explain_zh: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

sets.example_en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
sets.example_zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。
sets.explain_zh: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

sets.example_en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
sets.example_zh: 我在你的早餐碗旁留了一张便条。
sets.explain_zh: 记笔记用take notes；note that后接完整句子。

sets.example_en: Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.
sets.example_zh: 用自己的话记笔记的学生可能会对复杂的学习材料形成更深入的理解。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
sets.example_zh: 导游讲述了这座古堡的历史。
sets.explain_zh: historical指与历史有关；historic指有历史意义。

sets.example_en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
sets.example_zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
sets.explain_zh: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

sets.example_en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
sets.example_zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Can you drive me to the station after breakfast?
sets.example_zh: 早饭后你能开车送我去车站吗？
sets.explain_zh: 不规则变化：drive—drove—driven；送某人用drive sb to。

sets.example_en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
sets.example_zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。
sets.explain_zh: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

sets.example_en: What type of bread would you like today?
sets.example_zh: 你今天想要哪种面包？
sets.explain_zh: type of后接名词；表示多种类型用types of。

sets.example_en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
sets.example_zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。
sets.explain_zh: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

sets.example_en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
sets.example_zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。
sets.explain_zh: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

sets.example_en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
sets.example_zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
sets.example_zh: 我们做饭时，轻柔的音乐在厨房里飘荡。
sets.explain_zh: music不可数；一首乐曲说a piece of music。

sets.example_en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。
sets.explain_zh: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。

sets.example_en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We often discuss political issues around the dinner table.
sets.example_zh: 我们经常在餐桌上讨论政治问题。
sets.explain_zh: political是形容词；politics指政治，politician指政治家。

sets.example_en: Political stability can encourage long-term investment and help governments maintain essential public services.
sets.example_zh: 政治稳定能够鼓励长期投资，并帮助政府维持必要的公共服务。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
sets.example_zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。
sets.explain_zh: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

sets.example_en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
sets.example_zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？
sets.explain_zh: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

sets.example_en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
sets.example_zh: 等一会儿，我穿上鞋就好。
sets.explain_zh: at the moment指现在；in a moment指马上。

sets.example_en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
sets.example_zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。
sets.explain_zh: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

sets.example_en: Our school has a policy of serving fresh fruit daily.
sets.example_zh: 我们学校规定每天供应新鲜水果。
sets.explain_zh: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

sets.example_en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
sets.example_zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。
sets.explain_zh: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

sets.example_en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
sets.example_zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
sets.example_zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。
sets.explain_zh: body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

sets.example_en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
sets.example_zh: 请在这里等一下，我去找钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: 等人用wait for someone；等着做用wait to do。

sets.example_en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
sets.example_zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。
sets.explain_zh: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

sets.example_en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
sets.example_zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。
sets.explain_zh: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

sets.example_en: The puppy ran toward me with a muddy ball.
sets.example_zh: 小狗叼着一个沾满泥的球向我跑来。
sets.explain_zh: toward与towards同义；前者美式更常用。

sets.example_en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
sets.example_zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。
sets.explain_zh: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

sets.example_en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
sets.example_zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。
sets.explain_zh: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

sets.example_en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
sets.example_zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
sets.example_zh: 老师给每个孩子单独发了一盒彩色蜡笔。
sets.explain_zh: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。

sets.example_en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
sets.example_zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。
sets.explain_zh: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

sets.example_en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
sets.example_zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。
sets.explain_zh: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

sets.example_en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
sets.example_zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。
sets.explain_zh: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。

sets.example_en: A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
sets.example_zh: 嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
sets.example_zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
sets.explain_zh: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

sets.example_en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
sets.example_zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。
sets.explain_zh: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

sets.example_en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
sets.example_zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。
sets.explain_zh: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

sets.example_en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
sets.example_zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。
sets.explain_zh: pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。

sets.example_en: Investing in renewable energy can produce long-term benefits for both local communities and the environment.
sets.example_zh: 投资可再生能源可以为当地社区和环境带来长期益处。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。

sets.example_en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
sets.example_zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

sets.example_en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
sets.example_zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。
sets.explain_zh: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

sets.example_en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
sets.example_zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。
sets.explain_zh: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

sets.example_en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
sets.example_zh: 法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。
sets.explain_zh: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

sets.example_en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
sets.example_zh: 暴风雨把我包里的东西全弄湿了。
sets.explain_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everything is ready。

sets.example_en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
sets.example_zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。
sets.explain_zh: cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

sets.example_en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
sets.example_zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。
sets.explain_zh: 纸不可数，用a piece of paper；论文、报纸可数。

sets.example_en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
sets.example_zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
sets.explain_zh: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

sets.example_en: We found a quiet café near the station.
sets.example_zh: 我们在车站附近找到了一家安静的咖啡馆。
sets.explain_zh: near可直接接地点；nearly通常表示“几乎”。

sets.example_en: We found a quiet café near the station.
sets.example_zh: 我们在车站附近找到了一家安静的咖啡馆。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
sets.example_zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。
sets.explain_zh: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

sets.example_en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
sets.example_zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
sets.example_zh: 我编辑度假照片时，电脑卡住了。
sets.explain_zh: 在电脑上工作用work on a computer。

sets.example_en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
sets.example_zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。
sets.explain_zh: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

sets.example_en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
sets.example_zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The hotel staff helped us carry our heavy bags.
sets.example_zh: 酒店的工作人员帮我们搬了沉重的行李。
sets.explain_zh: 单个员工用a member of staff，不说a staff。

sets.example_en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
sets.example_zh: 下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。
sets.explain_zh: 具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。

sets.example_en: The programme encourages regular physical activity among older adults.
sets.example_zh: 这项计划鼓励老年人进行规律的身体活动。

sets.example_en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
sets.explain_zh: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

sets.example_en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
sets.example_zh: 我每天早晨拉开窗帘，给植物浇水。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指用in the morning；具体某天早上用on。

sets.example_en: Schools that start later in the morning may help teenagers get enough sleep and concentrate better.
sets.example_zh: 上午较晚上课的学校可能有助于青少年获得充足睡眠，更好地集中注意力。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。
sets.explain_zh: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

sets.example_en: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
sets.example_zh: 我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。
sets.explain_zh: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。

sets.example_en: Students can open a bank account after arriving in the city.
sets.example_zh: 学生抵达这座城市后可以开设银行账户。

sets.example_en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
sets.example_zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。
sets.explain_zh: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

sets.example_en: The storm caused major damage to our roof.
sets.example_zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们的屋顶。
sets.explain_zh: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

sets.example_en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
sets.example_zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。
sets.explain_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。

sets.example_en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
sets.example_zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。
sets.explain_zh: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

sets.example_en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
sets.example_zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。
sets.explain_zh: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

sets.example_en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
sets.example_zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。
sets.explain_zh: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

sets.example_en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
sets.example_zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。
sets.explain_zh: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

sets.example_en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
sets.example_zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
sets.example_zh: 我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。
sets.explain_zh: sometimes是有时；some time是一段时间。

sets.example_en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
sets.example_zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。
sets.explain_zh: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

sets.example_en: The agreement includes improvements in working conditions.
sets.example_zh: 协议包括对工作条件的改善。

sets.example_en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
sets.example_zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？
sets.explain_zh: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

sets.example_en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
sets.example_zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

sets.example_en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
sets.example_zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。
sets.explain_zh: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

sets.example_en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
sets.example_zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。
sets.explain_zh: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

sets.example_en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
sets.example_zh: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。
sets.explain_zh: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

sets.example_en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
sets.example_zh: 我确信自己把钥匙放在厨房桌上了。
sets.explain_zh: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

sets.example_en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
sets.example_zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
sets.example_zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。
sets.explain_zh: look forward to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
sets.example_zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。
