sets.example_zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。
sets.explain_zh: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

sets.example_en: The new bike scheme lets students borrow cycles cheaply.
sets.example_zh: 新的自行车方案让学生能便宜地借车。

sets.example_en: The shop accepts payment by card or cash.
sets.example_zh: 这家商店接受刷卡或现金付款。
sets.explain_zh: 支付行为通常不可数；一笔款项可用a payment。

sets.example_en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
sets.example_zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。
sets.explain_zh: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

sets.example_en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
sets.example_zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。
sets.explain_zh: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

sets.example_en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
sets.example_zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。
sets.explain_zh: 鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

sets.example_en: These muddy footprints demonstrate that someone entered the kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 这些泥脚印表明有人进过厨房。
sets.explain_zh: 证明某事常用demonstrate that从句。

sets.example_en: These muddy footprints demonstrate that someone entered the kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 这些泥脚印表明有人进过厨房。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Your contribution helped us finish the garden before sunset.
sets.example_zh: 有了你的帮助，我们在日落前完成了花园的整理工作。
sets.explain_zh: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: I really appreciate you watering my plants while I was away.
sets.example_zh: 非常感谢你在我不在的时候帮忙给植物浇水。
sets.explain_zh: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

sets.example_en: I read one chapter before turning off the light.
sets.example_zh: 我读了一章才关灯。
sets.explain_zh: 书的“章”用chapter；章内较小部分常用section。

sets.example_en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
sets.example_zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。
sets.explain_zh: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: Apparently, the bakery closes early on rainy days.
sets.example_zh: 听说那家面包店下雨天会提早关门。
sets.explain_zh: 表示据现有信息推测，不保证事实确实如此。

sets.example_en: I finished the novel on the train yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 我昨天在火车上读完了这部长篇小说。
sets.explain_zh: 作名词指长篇小说；作形容词指新颖的。

sets.example_en: The union helped staff negotiate better working hours.
sets.example_zh: 工会帮助员工协商争取到了更合理的工作时间。
sets.explain_zh: union以辅音/j/开头，因此说a union而非an union。

sets.example_en: Too much sun can burn your skin at the beach.
sets.example_zh: 在海滩上，阳光太强会晒伤你的皮肤。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
sets.example_zh: 在家种菜是这里流行的一种风尚。
sets.explain_zh: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

sets.example_en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
sets.example_zh: 看到价格后，我最初的兴奋消退了。
sets.explain_zh: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

sets.example_en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
sets.example_zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
sets.example_zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。
sets.explain_zh: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

sets.example_en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
sets.example_zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
sets.example_zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。
sets.explain_zh: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

sets.example_en: Your support was critical when I started my business.
sets.example_zh: 我创业时，你的支持至关重要。
sets.explain_zh: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。

sets.example_en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
sets.example_zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。
sets.explain_zh: I gather that...表示“我听说或推断……”。

sets.example_en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
sets.example_zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
sets.example_zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。
sets.explain_zh: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

sets.example_en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。
sets.explain_zh: 指行星时常写Earth；on earth中不加the。

sets.example_en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
sets.example_zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。
sets.explain_zh: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

sets.example_en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
sets.example_zh: 这次冬日散步必须穿一件暖和的外套。
sets.explain_zh: 名词常用复数 essentials，表示必需品或基本要点。

sets.example_en: His desire to make the team kept him running before breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 他想进队的欲望让他早饭前坚持跑步。

sets.example_en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
sets.example_zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。
sets.explain_zh: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

sets.example_en: Our kitchen is currently full of boxes from the move.
sets.example_zh: 我们的厨房目前堆满了搬家用的箱子。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“目前”，常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

sets.example_en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
sets.example_zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。
sets.explain_zh: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

sets.example_en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
sets.example_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走向海滩。
sets.explain_zh: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。

sets.example_en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
sets.example_zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。
sets.explain_zh: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

sets.example_en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。
sets.explain_zh: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

sets.example_en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
sets.example_zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
sets.example_zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。
sets.explain_zh: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

sets.example_en: Schools should encourage students to engage in community activities that develop cooperation and a sense of responsibility.
sets.example_zh: 学校应鼓励学生参与社区活动，培养合作能力和责任感。
sets.explain_zh: 参与活动用engage in；与人互动用engage with。

sets.example_en: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
sets.example_zh: 大风把我们的花园椅子吹到了草地上。
sets.explain_zh: 通常作形容词；副词用powerfully，不用powerful。

sets.example_en: She picked a yellow flower from the pot by the window.
sets.example_zh: 她从窗边的花盆里摘了一朵黄花。
sets.explain_zh: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: The broken water pipe caused a crisis at home.
sets.example_zh: 水管破裂让家里陷入了困境。
sets.explain_zh: 复数为crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/，注意词尾发音。

sets.example_en: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
sets.example_zh: 住房危机迫使许多年轻人推迟搬进自己的住所。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The two teams must settle the argument after the game.
sets.example_zh: 两支队伍必须在比赛结束后解决这场争执。

sets.example_en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
sets.example_zh: 我们租了一条小船，游览了湖面。
sets.explain_zh: by boat不加冠词；on a boat表示在船上。

sets.example_en: In remote coastal communities, travelling by boat remains essential for accessing schools and medical services.
sets.example_zh: 在偏远的沿海社区，乘船出行仍是获得教育和医疗服务的重要方式。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
sets.example_zh: 志愿者为村子送来了食物和医疗援助。
sets.explain_zh: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

sets.example_en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
sets.example_zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

sets.example_en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
sets.example_zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
sets.example_zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。
sets.explain_zh: in the kitchen表示在厨房；ch读/tʃ/。

sets.example_en: Shared kitchen facilities can encourage social interaction among students living in university accommodation away from home.
sets.example_zh: 共用厨房设施能促进离家住在大学宿舍的学生之间的社交互动。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
sets.example_zh: 我检查了两次包，却没找到钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: 两倍常用twice as…as或twice the＋名词。

sets.example_en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
sets.example_zh: 每周至少锻炼两次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。
sets.explain_zh: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

sets.example_en: Heavy rain may delay the school bus this afternoon.
sets.example_zh: 大雨可能会让校车今天下午晚点。
sets.explain_zh: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
sets.example_zh: 为了你自身的安全，请戴上头盔。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

sets.example_en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
sets.example_zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道设计，也需要更严格地执行交通法规。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
sets.example_zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。
sets.explain_zh: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

sets.example_en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
sets.example_zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。
sets.explain_zh: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

sets.example_en: Our travel insurance covered the cost of my lost suitcase.
sets.example_zh: 我们的旅行保险赔付了我丢失行李箱的费用。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；保险费用premium，保单用policy。

sets.example_en: Affordable health insurance can prevent families from facing serious financial difficulties when someone becomes ill.
sets.example_zh: 价格可负担的医疗保险可以避免家庭在有人生病时陷入严重的经济困境。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
sets.example_zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。
sets.explain_zh: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

sets.example_en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
sets.example_zh: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。
sets.explain_zh: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。

sets.example_en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
sets.example_zh: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
sets.example_zh: 我们买椅子之前量了桌子的长度。
sets.explain_zh: at length常指“详细地”，不是“在长度上”。

sets.example_en: An investigation revealed why the kitchen ceiling was leaking.
sets.example_zh: 一项调查查明了厨房天花板漏水的原因。
sets.explain_zh: 调查某事用investigation into；under investigation指正被调查。

sets.example_en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早晨，一个小包裹送到了我们家门口。
sets.explain_zh: 指邮寄的包裹时，英式英语也常用parcel。

sets.example_en: The government introduced a support package to help small businesses invest in cleaner production methods.
sets.example_zh: 政府推出了一揽子扶持措施，帮助小企业投资更清洁的生产方式。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
sets.example_zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。
sets.explain_zh: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

sets.example_en: Universities should expand access to online courses while ensuring that disadvantaged students have adequate equipment and internet connections.
sets.example_zh: 大学应扩大在线课程的覆盖范围，同时确保弱势学生拥有足够的设备和网络条件。
sets.explain_zh: “详述”用expand on/upon；扩大某物可直接接宾语。

sets.example_en: Universities should expand access to online courses while ensuring that disadvantaged students have adequate equipment and internet connections.
sets.example_zh: 大学应扩大在线课程的覆盖范围，同时确保弱势学生拥有足够的设备和网络条件。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Governments must commit sufficient resources to public transport if they want to reduce urban traffic congestion.
sets.example_zh: 如果政府想缓解城市交通拥堵，就必须向公共交通投入充足的资源。
sets.explain_zh: commit to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
sets.example_zh: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。
sets.explain_zh: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。

sets.example_en: The cat can jump from the chair onto the table.
sets.example_zh: 猫可以从椅子跳到桌子上。
sets.explain_zh: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: The museum displays an ancient weapon behind thick glass.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆将一件古代兵器陈列在厚玻璃后。
sets.explain_zh: 可数名词；武器的总称也可用weaponry。

sets.example_en: Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.
sets.example_zh: 更严格地管控武器销售可能有助于政府改善公共安全并减少暴力犯罪。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The kitchen is relatively small, but it feels bright.
sets.example_zh: 厨房比较小，但感觉很明亮。
sets.explain_zh: 表示比较后的程度，不等同于very。

sets.example_en: Our host welcomed us with warm bread and tea.
sets.example_zh: 主人用热面包和茶欢迎我们。
sets.explain_zh: a host of后接复数名词，表示“大量”。

sets.example_en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
sets.example_zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

sets.example_en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
sets.example_zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。
sets.explain_zh: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

sets.example_en: A broad path leads from the gate to the sports field.
sets.example_zh: 一条宽阔的小路从大门通向运动场。

sets.example_en: Long walks tire my grandfather, so we stop often.
sets.example_zh: 长时间走路会让爷爷疲倦，所以我们经常停下来。
sets.explain_zh: 动词英美均用tire；轮胎的英式拼写为tyre。

sets.example_en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
sets.example_zh: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。
sets.explain_zh: 季节前通常用in；泉和弹簧义均为可数名词。

sets.example_en: Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
sets.example_zh: 春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
sets.example_zh: 即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

sets.example_en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
sets.example_zh: 社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
sets.example_zh: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指吃午餐用have lunch，通常不加冠词。

sets.example_en: The actual bill was much lower than we expected.
sets.example_zh: 实际账单金额比我们预想的低得多。
sets.explain_zh: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

sets.example_en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
sets.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。
sets.explain_zh: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。

sets.example_en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。
sets.explain_zh: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

sets.example_en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
sets.example_zh: 一起包饺子是我们家的传统。
sets.explain_zh: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。

sets.example_en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
sets.example_zh: 我在钱包里放了一些现金，以备急用。
sets.explain_zh: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

sets.example_en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.
sets.example_zh: 尽管电子支付日益普及，许多小商家仍然更希望顾客用现金付款。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
sets.example_zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。
sets.explain_zh: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

sets.example_en: She received an award for the best science project.
sets.example_zh: 她因为科学项目做得最好而获得了一个奖。

sets.example_en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
sets.example_zh: 我们的教练示范了如何握球拍。
sets.explain_zh: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。

sets.example_en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
sets.example_zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。
sets.explain_zh: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

sets.example_en: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller flat.
sets.example_zh: 经过仔细考虑，我们选择了那套较小的公寓。
sets.explain_zh: 表考虑或体谅通常不可数；表考虑因素时可数。

sets.example_en: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller flat.
sets.example_zh: 经过仔细考虑，我们选择了那套较小的公寓。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
sets.example_zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。
sets.explain_zh: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

sets.example_en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
sets.example_zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I forgot the code for my bicycle lock again.
sets.example_zh: 我又忘了自行车锁的密码。
sets.explain_zh: 程序代码通常不可数；一组密码可说a code。

sets.example_en: Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.
sets.example_zh: 教学生编写代码可以增强解决问题的能力，帮助他们适应不断变化的就业市场。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
sets.example_zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。
sets.explain_zh: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

sets.example_en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
sets.example_zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The rising river poses a threat to our village.
sets.example_zh: 不断上涨的河水对我们村庄构成威胁。
sets.explain_zh: 名词用 threat；动词用 threaten。

sets.example_en: Untreated waste can pose a threat to river ecosystems.
sets.example_zh: 未经处理的废物可能对河流生态系统构成威胁。

sets.example_en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
sets.example_zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。
sets.explain_zh: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

sets.example_en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
sets.example_zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。
sets.explain_zh: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

sets.example_en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
sets.example_zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
sets.example_zh: 政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。
sets.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

sets.example_en: This card will enable you to borrow library books.
sets.example_zh: 这张卡能让你借阅图书馆的书。

sets.example_en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
sets.example_zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。
sets.explain_zh: 通常作表语，不放名词前；用afraid of或afraid to do。

sets.example_en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
sets.example_zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
sets.example_zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。
sets.explain_zh: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

sets.example_en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
sets.example_zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: These results let us conclude that the plant needs more sun.
sets.example_zh: 这些结果让我们得出结论：这种植物需要更多阳光。

sets.example_en: Many religious festivals include special family meals.
sets.example_zh: 许多宗教节日都包含特别的家庭聚餐。

sets.example_en: Doctors are working hard to treat lung cancer.
sets.example_zh: 医生们正在努力治疗肺癌。

sets.example_en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
sets.example_zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。
sets.explain_zh: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

sets.example_en: Bus fares vary depending on how far you travel.
sets.example_zh: 公交车费会随乘车距离而变化。
sets.explain_zh: vary from A to B表示范围；vary in表示某方面不同。

sets.example_en: Access to affordable housing can vary considerably between regions, affecting where young professionals choose to live.
sets.example_zh: 各地区获得可负担住房的机会可能差别很大，从而影响年轻职场人士的居住选择。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
sets.example_zh: 我们学校组织了一项清理河流的环保活动。
sets.explain_zh: environmental是形容词，环境本身用environment。

sets.example_en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
sets.example_zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。
sets.explain_zh: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

sets.example_en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
sets.example_zh: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。
sets.explain_zh: 既可形容身体健康，也可形容饮食等有益健康。

sets.example_en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
sets.example_zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。
sets.explain_zh: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

sets.example_en: The experiment measures the volume of water in each container.
sets.example_zh: 这个实验测量每个容器中水的体积。
sets.explain_zh: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

sets.example_en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
sets.example_zh: 这家咖啡馆坐落在河边，位置很不错。
sets.explain_zh: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。

sets.example_en: My aunt plans to invest in a small bakery.
sets.example_zh: 我姑姑打算投资一家小面包店。
sets.explain_zh: 常用invest in；投入时间做事可用invest time in doing。

sets.example_en: We can proceed with dinner once everyone arrives.
sets.example_zh: 等大家都到了，我们就可以继续安排晚餐了。
sets.explain_zh: proceed是动词；表示收入的名词是proceeds。

sets.example_en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
sets.example_zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。
sets.explain_zh: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。

sets.example_en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
sets.example_zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
sets.example_zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。
sets.explain_zh: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。

sets.example_en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
sets.example_zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。
sets.explain_zh: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

sets.example_en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
sets.example_zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
sets.example_zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。
sets.explain_zh: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

sets.example_en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
sets.example_zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I like tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.
sets.example_zh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟喜欢咖啡。

sets.example_en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
sets.example_zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。
sets.explain_zh: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。

sets.example_en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
sets.example_zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
sets.example_zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。
sets.explain_zh: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

sets.example_en: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
sets.example_zh: 她为买一辆新自行车攒了一小笔钱。
sets.explain_zh: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

sets.example_en: We watched a film about a detective investigating a murder.
sets.example_zh: 我们看了一部讲述侦探调查谋杀案的电影。
sets.explain_zh: murder强调非法且故意杀人；kill含义更广。

sets.example_en: Governments should monitor air quality regularly to assess whether environmental policies are effectively reducing pollution.
sets.example_zh: 政府应定期监测空气质量，以评估环境政策是否有效减少了污染。
sets.explain_zh: 作动词可直接接宾语：monitor changes监测变化。

sets.example_en: Governments should monitor air quality regularly to assess whether environmental policies are effectively reducing pollution.
sets.example_zh: 政府应定期监测空气质量，以评估环境政策是否有效减少了污染。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
sets.example_zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。
sets.explain_zh: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

sets.example_en: The bank agreed to finance our new bakery.
sets.example_zh: 银行同意为我们的新面包店提供资金。
sets.explain_zh: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。

sets.example_en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
sets.example_zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。
sets.explain_zh: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

sets.example_en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
sets.example_zh: 她把一个鸡蛋打进了热煎锅。
sets.explain_zh: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

sets.example_en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。
sets.explain_zh: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

sets.example_en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
sets.example_zh: 租金突然上涨，让人十分震惊。
sets.explain_zh: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。

sets.example_en: Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.
sets.example_zh: 移居国外可能带来文化冲击，尤其是当日常习俗与本国差异很大时。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
sets.example_zh: 这把柔软的椅子很舒服，足以让人午睡一会儿。
sets.explain_zh: comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

sets.example_en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
sets.example_zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。
sets.explain_zh: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

sets.example_en: Please handle the glass carefully.
sets.example_zh: 拿玻璃杯请小心。

sets.example_en: She split a pack of crayons with her younger sister.
sets.example_zh: 她和妹妹合用了一包蜡笔。

sets.example_en: I still recall the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
sets.example_zh: 我仍然记得祖母厨房里的气味。
sets.explain_zh: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

sets.example_en: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
sets.example_zh: 这家餐馆在这款蘑菇酱里加了少量葡萄酒。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指葡萄酒时不可数；多种葡萄酒可用wines。

sets.example_en: Climate change is affecting wine production as rising temperatures alter grape quality and harvest times.
sets.example_zh: 气候变化正在影响葡萄酒生产，因为气温上升改变了葡萄品质和采收时间。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She raised her camera to photograph the sleeping cat.
sets.example_zh: 她举起相机，给熟睡的猫拍照。
sets.explain_zh: camera可指照相机或摄像机，具体看语境。

sets.example_en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
sets.example_zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。
sets.explain_zh: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

sets.example_en: Companies that manufacture electronic devices should take greater responsibility for recycling their products at the end of use.
sets.example_zh: 制造电子设备的企业应承担更多责任，回收使用寿命结束的产品。
sets.explain_zh: 多指工厂批量生产；名词制造商是manufacturer。

sets.example_en: The old theater now hosts concerts and community events.
sets.example_zh: 这座老剧院如今举办音乐会和社区活动。

sets.example_en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
sets.example_zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。
sets.explain_zh: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

sets.example_en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
sets.example_zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
sets.example_zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

sets.example_en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
sets.example_zh: 我完全忘了带泳衣。
sets.explain_zh: 语气较强；正式写作中常可换用completely或entirely。

sets.example_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
sets.example_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
sets.explain_zh: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。

sets.example_en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
sets.example_zh: 一位访客把她的伞落在了我们前门旁。
sets.explain_zh: visitor指人；visit可作动词或名词。

sets.example_en: Living alone gives me freedom to choose my own routine.
sets.example_zh: 独居让我可以自由安排自己的日常生活。
sets.explain_zh: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

sets.example_en: Living alone gives me freedom to choose my own routine.
sets.example_zh: 独居让我可以自由安排自己的日常生活。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Construction of the new bridge started early this morning.
sets.example_zh: 新桥的建设今天一早开始了。
sets.explain_zh: 表示建造过程时不可数；under construction指在建。

sets.example_en: This little garden is very dear to my grandmother.
sets.example_zh: 祖母十分珍爱这座小花园。
sets.explain_zh: dear表“贵”主要用于英式口语；称呼常用Dear。

sets.example_en: My main objective is to finish the race.
sets.example_zh: 我的主要目标是跑完全程。
sets.explain_zh: 名词指目标；形容词指客观的，反义词为subjective。

sets.example_en: Researchers should remain objective when evaluating evidence about the effects of homework on student achievement.
sets.example_zh: 研究人员在评估家庭作业对学生成绩影响的证据时，应保持客观。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The flat is spacious; moreover, it has a balcony.
sets.example_zh: 这套公寓很宽敞，而且还有一个阳台。
sets.explain_zh: 正式递进副词；连接独立句时，前用句号或分号。

sets.example_en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
sets.example_zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。
sets.explain_zh: onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。

sets.example_en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
sets.example_zh: 我们在图书馆找到了这条街过去的照片。
sets.explain_zh: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。

sets.example_en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
sets.example_zh: 历史记录帮助研究人员了解过去的社会如何应对环境变化和经济不确定性。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our neighbours oppose building a road through the park.
sets.example_zh: 我们的邻居反对修建一条穿过公园的道路。
sets.explain_zh: oppose 后直接接名词或动名词，不加 to。

sets.example_en: A small bird landed on the lowest branch.
sets.example_zh: 一只小鸟落在了最低的树枝上。
sets.explain_zh: branch既指树枝，也指机构或学科的分支。

sets.example_en: Opening a local branch allows banks to provide essential services to communities with limited internet access.
sets.example_zh: 开设当地分行能让银行为互联网接入有限的社区提供必要服务。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We left our vehicle outside the small mountain hotel.
sets.example_zh: 我们把车停在了山间小旅馆外面。
sets.explain_zh: 指交通工具时是可数名词，不仅指汽车。

sets.example_en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
sets.example_zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。
sets.explain_zh: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

sets.example_en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
sets.example_zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。
sets.explain_zh: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

sets.example_en: String can bind these loose pages into one notebook.
sets.example_zh: 绳子可以把这些散页捆绑成一个笔记本。

sets.example_en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
sets.example_zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。
sets.explain_zh: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

sets.example_en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
sets.example_zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。
sets.explain_zh: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

sets.example_en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
sets.example_zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
sets.example_zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。
sets.explain_zh: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

sets.example_en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。
sets.explain_zh: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

sets.example_en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
sets.example_zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
sets.example_zh: 离边缘远一点，有掉下去的危险。
sets.explain_zh: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。

sets.example_en: The museum displayed an empty bomb casing behind glass.
sets.example_zh: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列了一个空炸弹壳。
sets.explain_zh: 词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。

sets.example_en: Construction projects may be delayed when workers discover an unexploded bomb left over from a past conflict.
sets.example_zh: 当工人发现过去冲突遗留的未爆炸弹时，建设项目可能会延期。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
sets.example_zh: 我的表亲毕业后参军了。
sets.explain_zh: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

sets.example_en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
sets.example_zh: 那级破损的台阶很危险，请避开它。
sets.explain_zh: dangerous是形容词；修饰动作要用dangerously。

sets.example_en: Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.
sets.example_zh: 维护不善的道路会给骑行者带来危险，尤其是在大雨中或天黑后。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
sets.example_zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

sets.example_en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
sets.example_zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

sets.example_en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
sets.example_zh: 地方议会修好了我们家附近的游乐场。
sets.explain_zh: council指议会或委员会；counsel指建议或劝告。

sets.example_en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
sets.example_zh: 地方议会修好了我们家附近的游乐场。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
sets.example_zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。
sets.explain_zh: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

sets.example_en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
sets.example_zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。
sets.explain_zh: 既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

sets.example_en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
sets.example_zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。
sets.explain_zh: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

sets.example_en: Investment in renewable energy can generate employment while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
sets.example_zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
sets.explain_zh: 及物动词，可接电力、收入、兴趣、想法等宾语。

sets.example_en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
sets.example_zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。
sets.explain_zh: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
sets.example_zh: 我们订购的食品杂货在开始做饭前刚好送到了。
sets.explain_zh: delivery指递送服务或过程；deliver是动词。

sets.example_en: He would not deny breaking the classroom window.
sets.example_zh: 他不会否认教室的窗户是他打破的。
sets.explain_zh: 否认做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
sets.example_zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。
sets.explain_zh: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

sets.example_en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
sets.example_zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？
sets.explain_zh: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

sets.example_en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
sets.example_zh: 我的卧室早晨阳光很充足。
sets.explain_zh: 可数名词；a two-bedroom flat指两居室公寓。

sets.example_en: Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.
sets.example_zh: 共用卧室的孩子可能会培养合作能力，但随着成长，他们也需要足够的隐私。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My sister loves to quote lines from old films.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐很喜欢引用老电影里的台词。
sets.explain_zh: quote引用原话；paraphrase用自己的话转述。

sets.example_en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
sets.example_zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。
sets.explain_zh: 词尾b不发音；climb a mountain不加介词。

sets.example_en: The two recipes are basically the same, except for spices.
sets.example_zh: 除了香料不同，这两份食谱基本一样。
sets.explain_zh: 用于概括核心情况；不等于“几乎不”的barely。

sets.example_en: The two recipes are basically the same, except for spices.
sets.example_zh: 除了香料不同，这两份食谱基本一样。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The film has no violence, so younger children can watch it.
sets.example_zh: 这部电影没有暴力，所以更小的孩子也可以看。

sets.example_en: The minister visited our school to meet the teachers.
sets.example_zh: 部长来到我们学校与教师们见面。
sets.explain_zh: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。

sets.example_en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
sets.example_zh: 这家小店主要卖新鲜面包和蛋糕。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“主要而非全部”；常放在实义动词前。

sets.example_en: Many rural communities depend mainly on agriculture, making them particularly vulnerable to changes in weather patterns.
sets.example_zh: 许多农村社区主要依赖农业，因此尤其容易受到天气模式变化的影响。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
sets.example_zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。
sets.explain_zh: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

sets.example_en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
sets.example_zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
sets.example_zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。
sets.explain_zh: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

sets.example_en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
sets.example_zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She answered my questions in a calm manner.
sets.example_zh: 她平静地回答了我的问题。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“礼貌、礼仪”用复数manners。

sets.example_en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
sets.example_zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。
sets.explain_zh: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

sets.example_en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
sets.example_zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。
sets.explain_zh: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

sets.example_en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
sets.example_zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。

sets.example_en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
sets.example_zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I heard a familiar voice outside the kitchen door.
sets.example_zh: 我听见厨房门外传来一个熟悉的声音。
sets.explain_zh: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

sets.example_en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
sets.example_zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
sets.example_zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。
sets.explain_zh: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。

sets.example_en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
sets.example_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。
sets.explain_zh: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

sets.example_en: The family picnic was a cheerful affair despite the rain.
sets.example_zh: 尽管下着雨，这次家庭野餐仍然很欢乐。
sets.explain_zh: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

sets.example_en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
sets.example_zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The airport handles both military and civil aircraft.
sets.example_zh: 这座机场既接待军用飞机，也接待民用飞机。
sets.explain_zh: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。

sets.example_en: Protecting civil rights requires accessible legal services and public institutions that treat all citizens fairly.
sets.example_zh: 保护公民权利需要便捷可及的法律服务，以及公平对待所有公民的公共机构。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Local authorities should locate new health centres near public transport routes to improve access for elderly residents.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府应将新的医疗中心设在公共交通线路附近，以方便老年居民就医。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。

sets.example_en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
sets.example_zh: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。
sets.explain_zh: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

sets.example_en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
sets.example_zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。
sets.explain_zh: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

sets.example_en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
sets.example_zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。
sets.explain_zh: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

sets.example_en: We took a domestic flight to the northern coast.
sets.example_zh: 我们乘坐国内航班去了北部海岸。
sets.explain_zh: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。

sets.example_en: We took a domestic flight to the northern coast.
sets.example_zh: 我们乘坐国内航班去了北部海岸。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
sets.example_zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
sets.explain_zh: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。

sets.example_en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
sets.example_zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Her belief in me helped me try again.
sets.example_zh: 她对我的信心让我愿意再试一次。
sets.explain_zh: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

sets.example_en: A rescue troop reached the village before the storm.
sets.example_zh: 一支救援军队在暴风雨来临前赶到了村子。
sets.explain_zh: 表示士兵常用复数troops；演员团用troupe。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: Governments sometimes deploy troops to deliver emergency supplies when natural disasters make civilian transport systems unusable.
sets.example_zh: 当自然灾害导致民用运输系统无法使用时，政府有时会派遣部队运送应急物资。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We called an engineer to solve the technical problem.
sets.example_zh: 我们请了一位工程师来解决这个技术问题。
sets.explain_zh: technical强调技术或专业知识，不等于高科技。

sets.example_en: Schools should teach technical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for a changing workplace.
sets.example_zh: 学校应在教授文化课程的同时传授技术技能，帮助学生适应不断变化的职场。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
sets.example_zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。
sets.explain_zh: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

sets.example_en: The alphabetical arrangement made our class list easy to read.
sets.example_zh: 名字按字母排列，我们的班级名单就好读了。
sets.explain_zh: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
sets.example_zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。
sets.explain_zh: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

sets.example_en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
sets.example_zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。
sets.explain_zh: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

sets.example_en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
sets.example_zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
sets.example_zh: 电灯开关就在厨房门后。
sets.explain_zh: switch on/off表示开关设备；switch to表示改用。

sets.example_en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
sets.example_zh: 电灯开关就在厨房门后。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
sets.example_zh: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。
sets.explain_zh: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

sets.example_en: My sister handles corporate travel for a small company.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐为一家小公司安排商务差旅。
sets.explain_zh: corporate指企业的；cooperative指合作的。

sets.example_en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
sets.example_zh: 走路回家的路程还算短，一路也很惬意。
sets.explain_zh: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。

sets.example_en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
sets.example_zh: 学校应公平分配资源，让背景不利的学生获得所需的支持。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
sets.example_zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。
sets.explain_zh: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

sets.example_en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
sets.example_zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: All students are encouraged to participate.
sets.example_zh: 鼓励所有学生参与。

sets.example_en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
sets.example_zh: 这段攀登很艰难，但沿途的风景让付出变得值得。
sets.explain_zh: 读音与rough押韵；形容肉时指难嚼、老。

sets.example_en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
sets.example_zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。
sets.explain_zh: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

sets.example_en: Our class representative asked for more books in the library.
sets.example_zh: 我们班的代表请求为图书馆增添书籍。
sets.explain_zh: 形容词常接of：representative of某群体。

sets.example_en: This small lift has a capacity of six people.
sets.example_zh: 这部小电梯最多能容纳六个人。
sets.explain_zh: 能力用capacity to do；身份用in one's capacity as。

sets.example_en: We crossed the border by train early this morning.
sets.example_zh: 我们今天一早乘火车越过了边境。
sets.explain_zh: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。

sets.example_en: Countries that share a border often need to cooperate closely on trade and environmental protection.
sets.example_zh: 接壤的国家往往需要在贸易和环境保护方面密切合作。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
sets.example_zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。
sets.explain_zh: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

sets.example_en: The mechanic's assessment was that the brakes needed replacing.
sets.example_zh: 修理工的判断是刹车需要更换。
sets.explain_zh: 评估某事用assessment of；动词形式是assess。

sets.example_en: Continuous assessment can provide a broader picture of student progress than a single final examination.
sets.example_zh: 与单次期末考试相比，持续性考核能够更全面地反映学生的进步。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
sets.example_zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。
sets.explain_zh: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

sets.example_en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
sets.example_zh: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
sets.explain_zh: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

sets.example_en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
sets.example_zh: 昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。
sets.explain_zh: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

sets.example_en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
sets.example_zh: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。
sets.explain_zh: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

sets.example_en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
sets.example_zh: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
sets.example_zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。
sets.explain_zh: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

sets.example_en: Stricter regulation of industrial waste could reduce water pollution and improve public health in nearby communities.
sets.example_zh: 加强对工业废物的监管可以减少水污染，并改善附近社区的公众健康。
sets.explain_zh: 具体条例可数；表示监管这一过程时通常不可数。

sets.example_en: Safety regulations require everyone here to wear a helmet.
sets.example_zh: 安全规定要求这里的每个人都戴头盔。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
sets.example_zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。
sets.explain_zh: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。

sets.example_en: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
sets.example_zh: 那位艺术家邀请我们参观她楼上明亮的工作室。
sets.explain_zh: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

sets.example_en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
sets.example_zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合适的鞋。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“本身的”时放名词后，如the city proper。

sets.example_en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
sets.example_zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的机器前，应接受适当培训。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
sets.example_zh: 我喜欢晚饭后听音乐放松。
sets.explain_zh: 人感到放松用relaxed；事物令人放松用relaxing。

sets.example_en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
sets.example_zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。
sets.explain_zh: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

sets.example_en: The technician replaced a broken component inside my laptop.
sets.example_zh: 技术员更换了我笔记本电脑里的一个损坏零件。
sets.explain_zh: a component of表示“……的组成部分”。

sets.example_en: Reliable public transport is a key component of urban planning that aims to reduce traffic congestion.
sets.example_zh: 可靠的公共交通是旨在缓解交通拥堵的城市规划的重要组成部分。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We cannot afford a new sofa this month.
sets.example_zh: 我们这个月买不起新沙发。
sets.explain_zh: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

sets.example_en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
sets.example_zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。
sets.explain_zh: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

sets.example_en: I suspect the cat knocked the cup off the table.
sets.example_zh: 我怀疑是猫把杯子从桌上碰掉了。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后；名词、形容词读/ˈsʌspekt/。

sets.example_en: Researchers suspect that prolonged screen use may affect sleep quality, although further evidence is needed.
sets.example_zh: 研究人员推测，长时间使用屏幕可能影响睡眠质量，不过仍需更多证据。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
sets.example_zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。
sets.explain_zh: a cup of后接饮品；cup作动词可表示用手捧住。

sets.example_en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
sets.example_zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Your description helped me find the little bakery.
sets.example_zh: 你的描述帮我找到了那家小面包店。
sets.explain_zh: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

sets.example_en: Practising with friends gave me confidence before the interview.
sets.example_zh: 和朋友一起练习让我在面试前有了信心。
sets.explain_zh: 对某人或某事有信心用confidence in。

sets.example_en: My uncle repairs industrial machines at a nearby factory.
sets.example_zh: 我叔叔在附近的一家工厂维修工业机器。
sets.explain_zh: industrial指工业的；industrious才指勤劳的。

sets.example_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste can protect rivers and improve the health of nearby communities.
sets.example_zh: 加强对工业废物的管控可以保护河流，并改善附近社区居民的健康。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
sets.example_zh: 我们的邻居经常抱怨交通噪声。
sets.explain_zh: 向某人投诉某事：complain to sb about sth。

sets.example_en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
sets.example_zh: 我们的邻居经常抱怨交通噪声。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Hearing her story gave me a completely different perspective.
sets.example_zh: 听了她的故事，我对事情有了完全不同的看法。
sets.explain_zh: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。

sets.example_en: An error in the booking left us without seats.
sets.example_zh: 预订出了差错，导致我们没有座位。
sets.explain_zh: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

sets.example_en: Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.
sets.example_zh: 尽早投入建筑维护资金可以遏制历史街区的衰落，并保留其独特风貌。
sets.explain_zh: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

sets.example_en: Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.
sets.example_zh: 尽早投入建筑维护资金可以遏制历史街区的衰落，并保留其独特风貌。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
sets.example_zh: 你可以在泳池报名参加游泳课。
sets.explain_zh: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。

sets.meaning_zh: 资产；有价值的人或事物
sets.example_en: The company lists the building as its largest asset.
sets.example_zh: 公司将这栋建筑列为其最大的资产。

sets.example_en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
sets.example_zh: 教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

sets.example_en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
sets.example_zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

sets.example_en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
sets.example_zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Please bring any documents relevant to your application.
sets.example_zh: 请带上与你的申请有关的所有文件。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“与……相关”用relevant to，不用with。

sets.example_en: Please bring any documents relevant to your application.
sets.example_zh: 请带上与你的申请有关的所有文件。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
sets.example_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。
sets.explain_zh: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

sets.example_en: Her calm leadership helped our team finish the project.
sets.example_zh: 她沉着的领导帮助我们团队完成了项目。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。

sets.example_en: Her commitment to gardening keeps the flowers blooming.
sets.example_zh: 她用心打理花园，让鲜花一直盛开。
sets.explain_zh: commitment to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

sets.example_en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
sets.example_zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式woke，过去分词woken；常与up连用。

sets.example_en: An expensive coat is not necessarily a warmer one.
sets.example_zh: 贵的大衣不一定更暖和。
sets.explain_zh: not necessarily 意为“不一定”，不是“一定不”。

sets.example_en: An expensive coat is not necessarily a warmer one.
sets.example_zh: 贵的大衣不一定更暖和。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
sets.example_zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。
sets.explain_zh: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

sets.example_en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
sets.example_zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
sets.example_zh: 我们为全家福选了一个木制相框。
sets.explain_zh: frame既可指实体框架，也可指组织表达的方式。

sets.example_en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
sets.example_zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。
sets.explain_zh: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。

sets.example_en: Caring for the puppy strengthened the bond between the sisters.
sets.example_zh: 照顾小狗加深了姐妹之间的感情。
sets.explain_zh: bond with sb指增进感情；issue bonds指发行债券。

sets.example_en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
sets.example_zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。
sets.explain_zh: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

sets.example_en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
sets.example_zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。
sets.explain_zh: hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。

sets.example_en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
sets.example_zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。
sets.explain_zh: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

sets.example_en: The doctor checked for internal injuries after the fall.
sets.example_zh: 摔倒之后，医生检查了有没有内伤。

sets.example_en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
sets.example_zh: 他用一条沉重的金属链锁好了自行车。
sets.explain_zh: a chain of后接复数名词，表示相连的一系列事物。

sets.example_en: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐学文学，总能推荐很棒的小说。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。

sets.example_en: A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.
sets.example_zh: 对科学文献的综述表明，经常运动可以改善心理健康。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The victim of the theft described his missing phone.
sets.example_zh: 这起盗窃案的受害人描述了他丢失的手机。
sets.explain_zh: 表示某事的受害者，用victim of。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: Neighbours brought warm blankets to the flood victims.
sets.example_zh: 邻居们给洪灾受害者送来了温暖的毯子。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities by increasing the frequency of flooding and damaging essential infrastructure.
sets.example_zh: 海平面上升增加了洪水发生的频率，并破坏重要基础设施，危及沿海社区。
sets.explain_zh: threaten to do指威胁要做；threaten sth可指危及某物。

sets.example_en: We agreed on a fair division of household chores.
sets.example_zh: 我们就家务的公平分工达成了一致。
sets.explain_zh: 还可指数学中的除法；divide 是对应动词。

sets.example_en: A clear division of responsibilities between local and national authorities can improve the delivery of public services.
sets.example_zh: 地方与中央部门之间明确划分职责，可以改善公共服务的提供。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Check that the ladder is secure before climbing up.
sets.example_zh: 爬上去之前，检查梯子是否稳固。
sets.explain_zh: secure可作形容词，也可作及物动词表示争取到。

sets.example_en: The magician's clever tricks never fail to amaze the children.
sets.example_zh: 魔术师巧妙的戏法总能让孩子们惊叹不已。
sets.explain_zh: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

sets.example_en: This tiny device tracks my steps throughout the day.
sets.example_zh: 这个小装置会记录我一整天的步数。
sets.explain_zh: device是名词；devise是动词，意为设计或想出。

sets.example_en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
sets.example_zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。
sets.explain_zh: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

sets.example_en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
sets.example_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。
sets.explain_zh: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

sets.example_en: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
sets.example_zh: 洗新毛衣之前，先看看标签。
sets.explain_zh: 英式过去式labelled，美式常用labeled。

sets.example_en: Effective policies should address the root of poverty rather than simply provide temporary financial assistance.
sets.example_zh: 有效的政策应解决贫困的根源，而不只是提供临时的经济援助。
sets.explain_zh: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。

sets.example_en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
sets.example_zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。
sets.explain_zh: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

sets.example_en: Rent is our biggest expense every single month.
sets.example_zh: 房租是我们每个月最大的一笔开支。
sets.explain_zh: 日常各项开支常用复数expenses；expensive是形容词。

sets.example_en: Could you change the channel before the film starts?
sets.example_zh: 电影开始前，你能换个频道吗？
sets.explain_zh: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

sets.example_en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
sets.example_zh: 一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。
sets.explain_zh: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

sets.example_en: On your recommendation, I started taking short evening walks.
sets.example_zh: 听了你的建议，我开始在傍晚散一小会儿步。
sets.explain_zh: recommendation后的that从句常用should或动词原形。

sets.example_en: After years of service, she reached the rank of captain.
sets.example_zh: 服役多年后，她晋升为上尉。
sets.explain_zh: rank可作名词或动词；ranking常指排名或榜单。

sets.example_en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
sets.example_zh: 平常的工作日都是从吃早餐和散步开始的。
sets.explain_zh: 用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。

sets.example_en: Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.
sets.example_zh: 在就业中心附近住房昂贵的大城市，通勤时间长是常见现象。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
sets.example_zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝西，能照到傍晚的阳光。
sets.explain_zh: 方位一般小写；the West指西方国家时大写。

sets.example_en: Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
sets.example_zh: 对该国西部的投资可以缩小地区差距，并创造就业机会。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
sets.example_zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。
sets.explain_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

sets.example_en: Every resident received a key to the shared garden.
sets.example_zh: 每位住户都拿到了一把公共花园的钥匙。
sets.explain_zh: resident指人；residential形容住宅或居住区。

sets.example_en: Local residents should be consulted before major changes are made to roads and public spaces.
sets.example_zh: 在对道路和公共空间进行重大改造之前，应征求当地居民的意见。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The campsite fee includes the provision of clean water.
sets.example_zh: 营地费用包含清洁用水的供应。
sets.explain_zh: 表“提供”不可数；表“条款”可数；provisions可指粮食。

sets.example_en: I cannot concentrate with the television playing so loudly.
sets.example_zh: 电视声音这么大，我没法集中注意力。
sets.explain_zh: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

sets.example_en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
sets.example_zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
sets.example_zh: 剩下的汤足够大家喝。
sets.explain_zh: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。

sets.example_en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
sets.example_zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格突变的冲击。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

sets.example_en: I entirely forgot about the soup on the stove.
sets.example_zh: 我把炉子上煮着的汤忘得一干二净。
sets.explain_zh: not entirely表示不完全，并非完全不。

sets.example_en: I strongly recommend taking a jacket on this walk.
sets.example_zh: 我强烈建议这次散步带上一件夹克。
sets.explain_zh: 常修饰recommend、oppose、believe，强调态度。

sets.example_en: I strongly recommend taking a jacket on this walk.
sets.example_zh: 我强烈建议这次散步带上一件夹克。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
sets.example_zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。
sets.explain_zh: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

sets.example_en: The dinner will consist of rice, soup, and fish.
sets.example_zh: 晚饭将由米饭、汤和鱼组成。
sets.explain_zh: consist of表组成，不用被动；consist in表在于。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: A recent graduate came back to coach our debate team.
sets.example_zh: 一位刚毕业的学生回来指导我们的辩论队。
sets.explain_zh: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。
sets.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

sets.example_en: Which brand of toothpaste do you usually buy?
sets.example_zh: 你通常买哪个牌子的牙膏？
sets.explain_zh: brand指品牌；trademark强调受法律保护的商标。

sets.example_en: Returning the lost wallet was clearly the moral choice.
sets.example_zh: 归还丢失的钱包显然是合乎道德的选择。
sets.explain_zh: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

sets.example_en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
sets.example_zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
sets.example_zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。
sets.explain_zh: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

sets.example_en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
sets.example_zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: This soup has a delicious combination of herbs and vegetables.
sets.example_zh: 这道汤把香草与蔬菜搭配得十分美味。
sets.explain_zh: 常用a combination of A and B表示两者结合。

sets.example_en: A combination of affordable housing and reliable public transport can improve living standards in growing cities.
sets.example_zh: 经济适用的住房与可靠的公共交通相结合，可以提高发展中城市的生活水平。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: No one should shout abuse at a player after a match.
sets.example_zh: 比赛结束以后，谁都不该冲着球员大骂。

sets.example_en: She dropped a few cubes of ice into her juice.
sets.example_zh: 她往果汁里放了几块冰。
sets.explain_zh: ice指冰时通常不可数；一块冰用an ice cube。

sets.example_en: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
sets.example_zh: 我们搬家的主要原因是交通噪声太大。
sets.explain_zh: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

sets.example_en: Students need opportunities to master practical skills rather than simply memorise information for examinations.
sets.example_zh: 学生需要掌握实用技能的机会，而不只是为考试背诵知识。
sets.explain_zh: 动词直接接宾语；硕士学位写作master's degree。

sets.example_en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
sets.example_zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。
sets.explain_zh: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

sets.example_en: Our first swimming session starts early tomorrow morning.
sets.example_zh: 我们的第一次游泳课明天一早开始。
sets.explain_zh: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。

sets.example_en: I got a good grade on my science project.
sets.example_zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。
sets.explain_zh: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

sets.example_en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
sets.example_zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The climb was tiring; nevertheless, we enjoyed the view.
sets.example_zh: 爬山很累，但我们仍然欣赏到了美景。
sets.explain_zh: 是副词，不是连词；连接独立句时可用分号。

sets.example_en: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
sets.example_zh: 他们预报有大雨，所以带上你的伞吧。
sets.explain_zh: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

sets.example_en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
sets.example_zh: 我先前在图书馆见过我们的邻居。
sets.explain_zh: previously意为先前；表示提前准备通常用in advance。

sets.example_en: This thick coat offers protection against the cold wind.
sets.example_zh: 这件厚外套能抵御寒风。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；protection from/against表示免受伤害。

sets.example_en: The beach was largely empty when we arrived.
sets.example_zh: 我们到达时，海滩上几乎没什么人。
sets.explain_zh: 表示主要或大体上，不表示物体体积很大。

sets.example_en: The couple plan to wed in their home town.
sets.example_zh: 这对伴侣计划在家乡结婚。

sets.example_en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
sets.example_zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。
sets.explain_zh: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

sets.example_en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
sets.example_zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Her final shot sent the ball into the net.
sets.example_zh: 她最后一脚射门把球踢进了球网。
sets.explain_zh: give it a shot表示试一试；shot也是shoot的过去式。

sets.example_en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
sets.example_zh: 重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。
sets.explain_zh: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

sets.example_en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
sets.example_zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。
sets.explain_zh: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

sets.example_en: Higher education does not guarantee employment, but it can significantly improve a person's long-term career prospects.
sets.example_zh: 高等教育并不保证就业，但能显著改善一个人的长期职业前景。
sets.explain_zh: 可接to do或that从句；保修期内用under guarantee。

sets.example_en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
sets.example_zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。
sets.explain_zh: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

sets.example_en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
sets.example_zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We chose a seaside theme for the birthday party.
sets.example_zh: 我们为生日聚会选了一个海滨主题。
sets.explain_zh: theme侧重贯穿作品的思想；topic多指讨论话题。

sets.example_en: The relationship between economic growth and environmental protection is a central theme in contemporary public debate.
sets.example_zh: 经济增长与环境保护之间的关系是当代公共讨论的核心主题。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Even a minor lapse in judgment can undermine public confidence in the management of essential services.
sets.example_zh: 即使是轻微的判断失误，也可能削弱公众对基本公共服务管理的信心。
sets.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

sets.example_en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
sets.example_zh: 冰箱里传出一股怪味。
sets.explain_zh: the odd加单数名词常表示偶尔的某事。

sets.example_en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
sets.example_zh: 冰箱里传出一股怪味。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。
sets.explain_zh: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。

sets.example_en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
sets.example_zh: 我们申请了一笔贷款来修屋顶。
sets.explain_zh: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

sets.example_en: Could you give me a simple definition of gravity?
sets.example_zh: 你能给我一个简单的重力定义吗？
sets.explain_zh: definition of引出被定义的概念；高清常缩写为HD。

sets.example_en: Citizens should elect representatives who are willing to address long-term environmental challenges rather than seek immediate popularity.
sets.example_zh: 公民应当选举愿意应对长期环境挑战的代表，而不是追求眼前人气的人。
sets.explain_zh: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。

sets.example_en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
sets.example_zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。
sets.explain_zh: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

sets.example_en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
sets.example_zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
sets.example_zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。
sets.explain_zh: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

sets.example_en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
sets.example_zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: A quick comparison helped me choose the cheaper bicycle.
sets.example_zh: 简单比较一下后，我选中了更便宜的自行车。
sets.explain_zh: 两者之间的比较用comparison between A and B。

sets.example_en: One striking characteristic of this cat is its curly fur.
sets.example_zh: 这只猫的一个显著特征是卷曲的毛。
sets.explain_zh: 形容词常用be characteristic of，表示是……的典型特征。

sets.example_en: One striking characteristic of this cat is its curly fur.
sets.example_zh: 这只猫的一个显著特征是卷曲的毛。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: You need a license to drive on public roads.
sets.example_zh: 你需要有驾驶执照才能在公共道路上开车。
sets.explain_zh: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。

sets.example_en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
sets.example_zh: 我靠自行车通勤。
sets.explain_zh: 不直接接宾语：用rely on或rely upon。

sets.example_en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
sets.example_zh: 我靠自行车通勤。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
sets.example_zh: 这条狭窄的小路只容得下我们排成一列走。
sets.explain_zh: narrow down表示缩小选择范围，不指道路变窄。

sets.example_en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
sets.example_zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。
sets.explain_zh: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

sets.example_en: The receptionist checked my identity before handing me the key.
sets.example_zh: 接待员核实我的身份后，才把钥匙交给我。
sets.explain_zh: identity指身份；identify是识别、确认身份的动词。

sets.example_en: Preserving local languages can strengthen cultural identity while helping communities pass traditional knowledge to younger generations.
sets.example_zh: 保护地方语言能够增强文化认同，同时帮助社区向年轻一代传承传统知识。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
sets.example_zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。
sets.explain_zh: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

sets.example_en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
sets.example_zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.
sets.example_zh: 地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。
sets.explain_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。

sets.example_en: Please take the doctor's advice seriously.
sets.example_zh: 请认真对待医生的建议。

sets.example_en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
sets.example_zh: 我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。
sets.explain_zh: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

sets.example_en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
sets.example_zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
sets.example_zh: 我打开饼干盒时，里面已经空了。
sets.explain_zh: empty强调里面没有东西；vacant常指房屋或职位空缺。

sets.example_en: An independent commission should investigate housing conditions before the government introduces new safety regulations for rental properties.
sets.example_zh: 在政府出台新的出租房安全法规前，独立委员会应调查住房状况。
sets.explain_zh: 作委员会是可数名词；作佣金常用不可数形式。

sets.example_en: An independent commission should investigate housing conditions before the government introduces new safety regulations for rental properties.
sets.example_zh: 在政府出台新的出租房安全法规前，独立委员会应调查住房状况。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
sets.example_zh: 每个手工碗的内侧都有独特的图案。
sets.explain_zh: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

sets.example_en: The parents' association organised the spring fair.
sets.example_zh: 家长协会组织了春季义卖。

sets.example_en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
sets.example_zh: 我姐姐每次排练都演奏不同的乐器。
sets.explain_zh: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。

sets.example_en: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
sets.example_zh: 学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: An investor asked for more information about the company's costs.
sets.example_zh: 一位投资者要求进一步了解公司的成本。

sets.example_en: The course gave me practical experience in repairing bikes.
sets.example_zh: 这门课程让我获得了修理自行车的实践经验。
sets.explain_zh: practical可强调亲手实践，也可表示实用、可行。

sets.example_en: The course gave me practical experience in repairing bikes.
sets.example_zh: 这门课程让我获得了修理自行车的实践经验。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
sets.example_zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。
sets.explain_zh: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。

sets.example_en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
sets.example_zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。
sets.explain_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。

sets.example_en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
sets.example_zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。
sets.explain_zh: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

sets.example_en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
sets.example_zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
sets.example_zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。
sets.explain_zh: “排、划船”读/rəʊ/；“争吵”英美均读/raʊ/。

sets.example_en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
sets.example_zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
sets.example_zh: 我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。
sets.explain_zh: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

sets.example_en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
sets.example_zh: 上楼前请把后门锁好。
sets.explain_zh: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。

sets.example_en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
sets.example_zh: 我们开车进山前停下来加了油。
sets.explain_zh: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。

sets.example_en: We packed warm coats in expectation of cold weather.
sets.example_zh: 我们预计天气会冷，就带上了厚外套。
sets.explain_zh: 表示对表现的期望时常用复数expectations。

sets.example_en: We packed warm coats in expectation of cold weather.
sets.example_zh: 我们预计天气会冷，就带上了厚外套。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She found employment at a bakery near her home.
sets.example_zh: 她在家附近的一家面包店找到了工作。
sets.explain_zh: 通常不可数；一份工作用a job，不用an employment。

sets.example_en: Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.
sets.example_zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时帮助各国实现气候目标。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
sets.example_zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。
sets.explain_zh: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

sets.example_en: The clinic offers confidential advice about sexual health.
sets.example_zh: 这家诊所提供保密的性健康咨询。
sets.explain_zh: sexual指与性有关；sexy才常表示性感的。

sets.example_en: The clinic offers confidential advice about sexual health.
sets.example_zh: 这家诊所提供保密的性健康咨询。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
sets.example_zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。
sets.explain_zh: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

sets.example_en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
sets.example_zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。
sets.explain_zh: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

sets.example_en: The bus has become increasingly crowded since last month.
sets.example_zh: 从上个月起，这趟公交车变得越来越拥挤。
sets.explain_zh: 直接修饰原级形容词：increasingly popular。

sets.example_en: The country will import oil.
sets.example_zh: 这个国家将进口石油。

sets.example_en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
sets.example_zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。
sets.explain_zh: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

sets.example_en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
sets.example_zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。
sets.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

sets.example_en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
sets.example_zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。
sets.explain_zh: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

sets.example_en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
sets.example_zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。
sets.explain_zh: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。

sets.example_en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
sets.example_zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。
sets.explain_zh: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

sets.example_en: The entire cast came outside to greet the audience.
sets.example_zh: 全体演员都走到外面向观众问好。
sets.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为cast；全体演员用单数形式。

sets.example_en: The study challenges the notion that longer working hours improve productivity.
sets.example_zh: 这项研究对工作时间越长效率越高的观念提出质疑。

sets.example_en: My uncle is conservative and dislikes changing family traditions.
sets.example_zh: 我叔叔很保守，不喜欢改变家里的传统。
sets.explain_zh: 小写通常指保守；大写可表示保守党的。

sets.example_en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
sets.example_zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
sets.explain_zh: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

sets.example_en: Strong opposition from parents saved the small village school.
sets.example_zh: 家长的强烈反对保住了那所乡村小学。
